narrative:
Good morning. Here is the FY2027 BU plan snapshot for Bupa Global & UK.

**Revenue** is planned at GBP 3.80B — up 6.3% on the FY2026 forecast and GBP 50M short of the GBP 3.85B ambition. UK Insurance contributes GBP 2.01B (53%); Clinics & Hospitals is the fastest-growing unit as King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals ramp up.

**Cost of care** is 74.1% of revenue. Medical inflation of 6.8% is the largest single driver, and agency staffing at 11.8% of clinical hours is above the 9% target.

**Underlying operating profit** is GBP 365M — a 9.6% margin, above the 9% floor.

**Key movements this week:**
• Corporate PMI renewals in London & South East priced ahead of claims inflation
• Mental-health claims rising fastest in the North — digital therapy pathway proposed
• Two large corporate schemes moved renewal dates into next month

**Pending your decision:** agent proposals on BU revenue targets, cost of care and workforce are waiting for approval.

signals.title: Bupa Global, India & UK revenue +11%, underlying profit +23%
signals.excerpt: Market unit revenue rose 11% to £3.1bn on customer growth and average premiums; underlying profit rose 23% to £154m.

signals.title: Bupa Insurance Ltd combined operating ratio stable at 97%
signals.excerpt: The COR for Bupa Insurance Limited, which underwrites both domestic and international insurance, remained stable at 97%, against 94% for the Group.

signals.title: UK Care Services occupancy up to 92%
signals.excerpt: UK Care Services grew revenue and underlying profit through increasing occupancy to 92% (HY25: 90%) and disciplined cost management.
